[P2] Revisit the untested name-type condition

Rule 4 requires every condition to have a test that fails without it. Both the new session tests and the existing operation validation tests supply only string names. Removing `not isinstance(name, str)` therefore leaves those assertions unchanged, although truthy non-string names would then pass the session validator. Testing removal of the entire name guard does not cover this separate condition. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, to settle the supported input contract and ensure every retained condition has a test that depends on it.
